user_outcomes: Transform explicit current role requirements and candidate-supplied job evidence into a provenance-preserving human-review packet with visible uncertainty
Compare evidence against each declared job requirement without producing a global person ranking or automatic employment disposition
Support candidate correction and challenge through reasoned human review and successor-state receipts
anti_goals: Do not automatically reject, shortlist, offer, schedule, contact or otherwise change a candidate's employment state
Do not create an immutable, hidden or cross-role global ranking, employability score or worth judgment
Do not infer protected attributes or proxies for protected attributes
Do not infer personality, emotion, deception, health, disability or psychological state from voice, face, video, writing style, interaction latency or other behavioral traces
Do not scrape social profiles, join unrelated contexts, perform background checks or use unrelated personal history
Do not access or mutate an ATS, mailbox, calendar, external account or communication channel
target_contexts: Normalization and human review of explicit job requirements before candidate comparison
Evidence-first review of candidate-supplied work history, skills, artifacts and declared constraints
Contestable preparation of a human decision packet before any separate employment decision process

actors.description: Human role that owns the exact hiring-support scope, role requirements and review process without delegating the employment decision to the product.
responsibilities: Define attributable and current job requirements
Ensure that only job-relevant evidence enters the bounded review
Record a reasoned disposition for the analysis packet
Preserve a separate employment-decision boundary
actors.authority_source: Explicit organizational assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Human reviewer who evaluates the bounded comparison packet and its uncertainty.
responsibilities: Review requirement relevance and evidence lineage
Inspect missing, stale and conflicting evidence
Reject, correct, narrow or accept the packet for further human review
Avoid treating the packet as an automatic decision
actors.authority_source: Explicit assignment by the human hiring owner outside this contract

actors.description: Candidate role that supplies bounded job evidence and may challenge or correct the resulting packet.
responsibilities: Supply or explicitly withhold job-relevant evidence
Identify corrections, context and source-lineage problems
Avoid submitting unrelated third-party or sensitive data
actors.authority_source: Participation in the bounded hiring-support process

actors.description: Human role that reviews candidate challenges independently from the original analysis-system output.
responsibilities: Review the predecessor evidence and recorded reasons
Consider candidate corrections without treating the challenge as a negative signal
Record an upheld, corrected, evidence-requested or paused successor state
actors.authority_source: Explicit appeal-review assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Local analysis component that produces job-relevance and evidence-lineage candidates without ranking people or causing external effects.
responsibilities: Preserve source lineage and requirement bindings
Separate evidence, interpretation, uncertainty and missing evidence
Avoid protected-attribute, proxy, personality, emotion, health and disability inference
Produce no global ranking or automatic disposition
Stop before ATS mutation, communication or employment action
actors.authority_source: No independent authority; bounded by the exact contract and admitted local runtime

actors.description: Protective assessment component that may identify scope, evidence or prohibited-feature risks but cannot reject a candidate or control a disposition.
responsibilities: Assess the exact comparison candidate against the declared product contract
Surface evidence, scope, correlation and prohibited-feature risks
Emit only a protective assessment candidate for human review
actors.authority_source: No independent authority; consumes the separately materialized FREESHIELD contract

inputs.description: The exact role purpose, tasks, job-relevant requirements, evidence standards, relevance rationales and current owner/frontier.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Each material requirement has an attributable owner, a job-relevance rationale, an evidence standard and a current validity frontier
inputs.freshness_policy: Any material role, task, requirement, evidence-standard or owner change creates a successor requirement set

inputs.description: Candidate-supplied work history, skills, work samples, certifications and contextual explanations intentionally submitted for this exact role.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Each material candidate claim has an attributable source or is explicitly marked unverified or unavailable
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact candidate submission version; corrections and additions create a successor package

inputs.description: Candidate-declared role-relevant preferences, constraints or explanations intentionally supplied for this review without inferred protected attributes.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Only context voluntarily supplied and demonstrably relevant to the declared role or process is included
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact candidate-declared version and invalidated by correction or withdrawal

inputs.description: Declared process scope, review roles, prohibited uses, evidence limits and separate employment-decision boundary.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: The review scope, allowed roles, prohibited features, contestability path and non-effects are explicit
inputs.freshness_policy: Any process, policy, role or contract change requires a successor review-constraints package

inputs.description: Protective assessment candidate bound to the exact comparison packet, Product Contract hash, evidence frontier and prohibited-feature rules.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: The assessment identifies the exact input packet, contract hash, frontier, scope, evidence sufficiency and any protective outcome candidate
inputs.freshness_policy: Invalidated by any material input, contract, requirement or frontier change

inputs.description: Candidate-supplied challenge, correction or contextual evidence bound to one exact predecessor review packet.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: The challenge identifies the disputed claim, requirement, evidence binding, reason or requested correction
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact predecessor packet and superseded only by a recorded successor challenge state

classes.collection_scope: Only current tasks, requirements, evidence standards and relevance rationales for the exact role
classes.minimization_rule: Exclude preferences that are not demonstrably job-relevant and exclude protected-attribute requirements or proxies
classes.retention_limit: Until the role is closed or the requirement set is superseded, subject to an explicit contestability period
classes.disclosure_scope: Candidate, human hiring owner, human reviewers and admitted local analysis components only

classes.collection_scope: Only job-relevant evidence intentionally supplied by the candidate for the exact role
classes.minimization_rule: Exclude protected attributes, unrelated personal history, social-profile data, behavioral biometrics and hidden third-party data
classes.retention_limit: Until the bounded process and declared contestability period end or earlier deletion is validly requested
classes.disclosure_scope: Candidate and declared human review roles; local analysis components receive only minimum necessary fields

classes.collection_scope: Only candidate-declared context necessary to interpret job evidence or process participation
classes.minimization_rule: Do not infer or expand the context into protected attributes, health, disability, personality or psychological profile
classes.retention_limit: Until the exact process closes, the context is withdrawn or a successor correction replaces it
classes.disclosure_scope: Candidate and explicitly assigned human review roles only

classes.collection_scope: Only process scope, roles, prohibited uses, evidence limits and contestability rules
classes.minimization_rule: Exclude account credentials, hidden decision heuristics and unrelated organizational data
classes.retention_limit: Until the process version is superseded and its contestability period closes
classes.disclosure_scope: Declared process owner, reviewers and validation components only

classes.collection_scope: Requirement-to-evidence bindings, uncertainty, conflicts and missing-evidence statements for one exact role and candidate package
classes.minimization_rule: No global ranking, employability score, protected-attribute proxy, personality or cross-role profile
classes.retention_limit: Until the packet is rejected, corrected, superseded or the contestability period closes
classes.disclosure_scope: Candidate and declared human review roles only

classes.collection_scope: FREESHIELD scope, evidence and prohibited-feature assessment for one exact comparison candidate
classes.minimization_rule: No candidate blacklist, hidden risk score, global prohibition or legal judgment
classes.retention_limit: Until human disposition or successor protective assessment
classes.disclosure_scope: Declared human review roles and candidate challenge process

classes.collection_scope: Only the disputed claim, evidence binding, candidate correction, reason and appeal disposition
classes.minimization_rule: A challenge must not be converted into a negative candidate signal or cross-process profile
classes.retention_limit: Until the challenge is resolved and the declared review period closes
classes.disclosure_scope: Candidate, human appeal reviewer and process owner only

analysis_effects.description: Normalize attributable role requirements, evidence standards and job-relevance rationales without adding hidden criteria.
Bind candidate claims to supplied sources or mark them unverified, unavailable or uncertain.
Map supplied evidence to each declared job requirement without producing a global person ranking.
Expose missing, stale, conflicting and insufficient job-relevant evidence without treating absence as negative evidence.
Prepare a requirement-by-requirement comparison candidate with reasons, uncertainty and non-effects for human review.
Prepare the exact comparison candidate and provenance bundle for a separate FREESHIELD protective assessment.
Assemble a local human-review packet that does not decide, rank, reject, shortlist, offer or contact.
Prepare a local successor candidate from a candidate challenge while preserving predecessor evidence and reasons.

human_gates.trigger: Before any comparison packet is treated as ready for further human hiring review
human_gates.expires_after: Any material requirement, evidence, context, protective-assessment, contract or frontier change

human_gates.trigger: When a candidate challenges or corrects an exact predecessor comparison or disposition packet
human_gates.expires_after: Any predecessor-packet, challenge-evidence, reviewer-role, contract or frontier change

contestability.challenge_input_scope: Role requirements, evidence lineage, job relevance, uncertainty, missing evidence, FREESHIELD protective assessment, comparison reasons and recorded disposition

dependencies.relationship: Consumes typed evidence, intent, authority, action-gate and successor-state distinctions
May express the bounded review request and explicit human handoffs without execution admission
Potential future carrier of exact-bound evidence and receipts; unused for external effects in this contract
Required protective assessment of the exact comparison candidate before it may be accepted for further human review
Optional future bounded responsibility lifecycle; this contract does not activate or require KONTUR

receipts.purpose: Record the exact role requirements, evidence standards, relevance rationales, owner and validity frontier.
assertions: Every material requirement is attributable and bound to the exact role frontier
Each material requirement states a job-relevance rationale and evidence standard
non_effects: The receipt does not prove that a requirement is lawful, necessary or non-discriminatory in every jurisdiction
The receipt does not authorize candidate comparison or an employment decision

receipts.purpose: Record requirement-by-requirement evidence bindings, uncertainty, conflicts, missing evidence and the FREESHIELD assessment reference.
assertions: Every material comparison statement is linked to supplied evidence or marked as interpretation, unverified, unavailable or UNKNOWN
No global person ranking or automatic disposition is emitted
The packet is bound to the exact role, candidate-evidence, contract and protective-assessment frontiers
non_effects: The receipt does not establish candidate identity, worth, personality, health, disability or protected attributes
The receipt does not reject, shortlist, offer, schedule, contact or otherwise change employment state
The receipt does not authorize ATS, mailbox, calendar, account or background-check mutation

receipts.purpose: Record the human disposition for one exact comparison packet before any separate employment-decision process.
assertions: The reviewed packet, reasons, uncertainty and human disposition are explicit
Correction, narrowing or evidence request creates a successor state
non_effects: Acceptance for human review is not an employment offer, rejection, shortlist or final decision
The disposition does not prove that any external action or communication occurred
The disposition does not create an ActionPermit

receipts.purpose: Record a candidate challenge, reviewed predecessor evidence, reasons and the resulting successor challenge state.
assertions: The challenge is bound to the exact predecessor packet and candidate-supplied correction
The human appeal disposition and reasons are explicit
The challenge itself is not treated as a negative candidate signal
non_effects: The receipt does not erase predecessor evidence or silently rewrite history
The receipt does not authorize an employment decision or external communication
An upheld predecessor packet is not proof of universal correctness or legal compliance

criteria.metric: Material role requirements carry an owner, validity frontier, evidence standard and job-relevance rationale
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of material requirements are attributable and challengeable or explicitly blocked as insufficient
criteria.falsification_condition: A material comparison criterion lacks an attributable requirement, relevance rationale or evidence standard

criteria.metric: Material candidate claims and comparison statements preserve source lineage or explicit uncertainty
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of material claims are linked to supplied evidence or marked unverified, unavailable or UNKNOWN
criteria.falsification_condition: A material factual claim or comparison appears without lineage, qualification or uncertainty

criteria.metric: Protected attributes, proxies, personality, emotion, deception, health, disability, social scraping and cross-context correlation are absent from the comparison
criteria.threshold: Zero prohibited feature uses or inferences in the exact packet
criteria.falsification_condition: Any prohibited attribute, proxy or behavioral inference affects the packet

criteria.metric: The output remains requirement-by-requirement and does not create a global person rank, employability score or immutable ordering
criteria.threshold: No global numerical or ordinal candidate ranking is emitted
criteria.falsification_condition: The system emits or relies on a global candidate score, rank or hidden ordering

criteria.metric: Missing, stale, conflicting and insufficient evidence remains visible through disposition
criteria.threshold: Every material uncertainty is retained or explicitly resolved through a bound successor receipt
criteria.falsification_condition: A material uncertainty disappears without evidence or a recorded reconciliation

criteria.metric: Candidate challenges can produce a reasoned human-reviewed successor state without becoming a negative signal
criteria.threshold: Every admitted challenge is bound to a predecessor packet and ends in a challenge receipt or explicit pending state
criteria.falsification_condition: A challenge is ignored, penalized, untraceable or changes the packet without a successor receipt

criteria.metric: The Product Contract and local analysis perform no ATS, communication, calendar, account, background-check or employment-state mutation
criteria.falsification_condition: Any external mutation, communication or employment-state change occurs under this contract

excluded_artifacts: Candidate resumes, applications, work samples, identity data, challenges and employment decisions
Organization-specific role requirements, policies, legal advice and compliance outcomes
Third-party models, ATS systems, background-check services, communication tools and external runtimes
Future product versions, general hiring ideas and artifacts not listed as included
ip_boundary.license_scope: Repository license; exact Product Contract v0.1 artifacts only

assertions: Product boundary described for the declared version and frontier
Effects are descriptive and denied by default
Human gates and contestability are explicit
The product emits only local job-relevance and evidence-lineage candidates
FREESHIELD assessment is an input to human review and not rejection authority
Candidate challenges create reviewable successor states and are not negative signals
A separate human-controlled employment-decision process remains outside this contract
non_effects: Candidate Evidence != Candidate Identity or Worth
Proxy Correlation != Permission to Infer a Protected Attribute
Interview Observation != Personality, Health or Disability Diagnosis
